notes: Prompt wording that gen_prompt.py adds to every hero prompt, kept here (not in the generator) so nothing is pushed into a prompt invisibly. Edit here, regenerate, review the diff. {placeholders} are filled by the generator.

keepLine.female: Maintain strict fidelity to the incoming image: the subject's face, eye colour, skin tone, makeup, figure, proportions and bust size, and the hair colour, highlights, length and full volume, all exactly as shown.
keepLine.male: Maintain strict fidelity to the incoming image: the subject's face, eye colour, skin tone, figure and proportions, and the hair colour, length and full volume, all exactly as shown.

bustKey: full, firm, voluptuous, noticeably enlarged, lifted high and pressed together at the centre in a deep, crisp, clearly defined cleavage held high, even where the reference bust is smaller or spread apart

figureNegatives.female: flat chest, small bust, narrow bust, flattened breasts, drooping breasts, sagging bust, low-hanging breasts, wide-set breasts, wide cleavage gap, reduced bust size, breasts spread apart, separated breasts, gap between breasts, widely spaced bikini cups

faceStyle.female: Makeup: soft and natural - {eyeshadow}-toned eyeshadow, {blush}, {brows}, softly defined eyes.
faceStyle.male: Grooming: natural, clean and well-groomed, {brows}, bare-faced.

defaultBreeze: A very slight lift from a light breeze below.
hairFromIncoming: the exact hairstyle, colour, highlights and length shown in the incoming image

standardFigure.notes: The figure the X Pose gets from the original photo (a card with figureProfile: standard). The individual build in each hero's physique is applied from the Bare stage on.

female.legs: Very long, slender legs with slim, tapering thighs

dragonMorphology.notes: Labels for the optional dragon identity fields, in this order; they make the {{MORPHOLOGY}} line of the dragon templates ({{MORPHOLOGY_HEAD}}, for the head close-up, uses only headFields).

grandeur.Rare: A little more ornate and imposing than usual.
grandeur.Epic: Ornate, imposing and clearly a cut above the ordinary.
grandeur.Legendary: Grand, imposing and legendary in scale.
grandeur.Mythic: Awe-inspiring and mythic in scale, radiating power.
grandeur.Transcendent: Transcendent, otherworldly and overwhelming in presence.
